entry.content:
Card format v2 groundwork: one clean primary meaning + concise alternatives

Not yet applied in bulk — this is the plumbing to prototype the new format on one
card and iterate.

- srs_cards.alt_meanings (other senses / idioms, small text on the back) +
  sentence_full (original long context, kept when `sentence` is trimmed to the
  clause with the word).
- llm.card_meaning(word, dict_form, sentence, current) -> {primary,
  primary_is_contextual, alt, context}: one cleanest general meaning as `primary`
  (contextual sense only when the usage is marked/idiomatic, and then `alt` leads
  with the general meaning); `context` is a substring-faithful trim to ~14 words.
- _study_card_view returns alt_meanings + a `reformatted` flag. studyReveal shows
  `.a-alt` under the big translation, and for reformatted cards shows ONLY the
  trimmed clause (no before/after context lines).
- Prototyped on card 413 (злоба): "malice / spite" → primary "malice" + alt;
  633-char paragraph → one clause; front стress fixed зло́ба.

entry.title: Offline mode: translate, make cards, review, and highlighting all wor…
entry.content:
Offline mode: translate, make cards, review, and highlighting all work offline

The offline story was patchy — reader/manual card-making was hard-blocked, there
was no offline translation, and the SRS bundle could silently be missing.

- OFFLINE TRANSLATION: /watch and /read now ship a `glossary` (lemma -> EN, from
  the local WikDict `dict_ru`) for the whole piece + a `.l` lemma on every word.
  The card modal falls back to this local gloss when the LLM is unreachable
  (`localGloss`); the card still gets a full LLM translation + stress on flush.
- OFFLINE CARD MAKING: every flow (watch / reader / legacy-text / manual) now
  queues to IDB and flushes when back online — the reader and manual "connect
  first" hard-blocks are gone. `FlushItem` gained `kind`/`text_id`/`chapter`/
  `note`; `_flush_one` dispatches to make-card / text_card / manual_card.
- OFFLINE HIGHLIGHTING: `LCARD` (localStorage set) remembers words carded/uncarded
  offline so a re-render from the stale server flag doesn't lose them
  (`applyLocalCards` after every transcript/reader render; `forgetLocalCard` on
  un-card). Verdict/delete/remove ops queue to a new `wordOut` store offline
  (`flushWordOut`), applied optimistically.
- OFFLINE REVIEW: `syncOfflineSRS(true)` on every launch (was a throttled 4s
  timer), 15-min interval; `loadStudyQueue` force-syncs if the bundle is missing
  instead of dead-ending on "connect once". Clearer empty message.
- `onReconnect` flushes cards + reviews + word-ops together, then refreshes the
  open view. `flushQueue` re-fetches /watch or /read after a successful flush so
  every inflected form greens. Queue pill counts all three queues.
- IDB v2 -> v3 (adds `wordOut`). `confirmCard` guards a null MODAL.

SW shell v102 -> v103.

entry.title: Introduce new cards learn-first, re-ranked daily by an LLM
entry.content:
Introduce new cards learn-first, re-ranked daily by an LLM

New cards used to enter the queue in creation order. Now a daily batched LLM
pass scores every not-yet-introduced card 0-100 (higher = a learner should meet
it sooner — real spoken/written frequency + usefulness, not how the word looks,
since the built-in freq list misleads), and queue() picks the day's fresh budget
by that score. Still shuffled within the day for presentation.

- srs_cards.learn_score column. srs._NEW_ORDER = learn_score DESC (nulls last)
  used by queue() + offline_bundle(); `list_cards(sort="learn")`.
- llm.learn_priority(items) — one call per 50 words, absolute 0-100 scale so
  batches are independent. `_LEARN_ORDER_SYSTEM` with an explicit tier rubric.
- main._rank_new_cards(rescore_all) + _maybe_rank_new() (fires from /srs/queue
  and /srs/stats when the day rolled over or unranked cards appeared; thread,
  never blocks; `_RANK_LOCK` dedups) + boot kick + POST /srs/rank-new.
  `app_settings.learn_rank_day` gates the daily re-rank.
- Card list gets a "learn-first" sort + an ≈score badge.
- Ranked the existing 269 un-introduced cards (пятно/платок/угрожать up top;
  ASR garble, dialect, slang, казуистика at the bottom).

SW shell v100 -> v101.

entry.title: Word verdicts: "learned" vs "not learning" (extensible)
entry.content:
Word verdicts: "learned" vs "not learning" (extensible)

Removing a card / dismissing a highlighted word used to collapse to one outcome
("known" — too easy). Now there's a choice, and the model is a registry so more
levels can be added later.

- app/wordstate.py — the registry. `learned` + `known` today; add a dict entry to
  add a level and the API / stats / word page / pick-a-verdict sheet all pick it
  up. `resolved_words.reason` carries the value (already free-text; any value
  suppresses re-suggestion, so nothing else in extraction changes).
- store: `set_word_state(lemma, reason)` (generalises `discard_word`),
  `clear_word_state` (undo → back in rotation), `word_state_counts`,
  `words_in_state`; `resolve_candidate(..., reason=)`; `delete_cards_for_lemma`
  now also returns the Anki note ids.
- API: `GET /words/states`, `POST|DELETE /words/{lemma}/state`,
  `GET /words?state=`, `DELETE /srs/cards/{id}?verdict=learned|known`,
  `word_detail` returns `verdict`, analytics returns `word_states`.
  `/words/{lemma}/discard` kept as a `state=known` alias.
- Frontend: one shared `#verdictWrap` sheet (`openVerdict`, registry-driven) wired
  into the green-word popover, the reader carded-word popover ("remove ▾"), the
  word page, study delete, and card-list delete. Each also offers "the card's
  wrong — remove it, keep suggesting" where a card/candidate id is known.
  New `#wordsView` list (learned / not-learning), reachable from two new
  Progress-screen cells.

entry.title: Calm, functional offline mode; fix downloaded-video playback offline
entry.content:
Calm, functional offline mode; fix downloaded-video playback offline

The red full-bleed "Can't reach the Mac / check Tailscale" banner fired whenever
/health failed with navigator.onLine true — i.e. on any captive / dead wifi, not
just a real server problem — and it overlaid the header, making the whole app
look broken.

- #connBanner is now a thin, calm, in-flow status line (never a full-bleed
  alarm, never overlays the header or a playing video). "noserver" while onLine
  shows the same calm "Offline — downloaded videos & saved reviews work · tap to
  retry" as true offline; header pill goes amber, not red.
- api() GETs get an 11s AbortSignal.timeout so a captive network fails fast to
  the cache instead of hanging the tab (POSTs unchanged — they have offline
  queues). SW shell fetch: 4s deadline + rejects a captive-portal login page
  (redirected / non-HTML) so the app always boots from cache.
- openWatch / startPlayer / openDetail use opfsPlayable() (fully downloaded, or —
  when there's no way to stream — a mostly-there partial) instead of the strict
  opfsHas(), so a stale `msz:` value can't hide a playable file. Removed the
  early bail that rejected a playable local file; clearer "not downloaded" vs
  "check your connection" messaging.
- openDetail hides the server-only Look-up / Review panels offline and skips the
  dead "Suggest vocabulary cards" panel; renderMediaRow shows "partly
  downloaded" instead of nothing. onReconnect re-populates the detail view.

entry.title: Fix reader words reverting after carding (archaic / irregular surface…
entry.content:
Fix reader words reverting after carding (archaic / irregular surface forms)

When you card a word whose surface form in the text lemmatises differently than
the LLM's citation form — Tolstoy's "сбирался" -> сбираться vs the card's
собираться — the reader flagged it off card_lemmas(), never matched, and the
word snapped back to un-carded on the next refresh. Tapping again made a fresh
duplicate card each time (5x собираться in Анна Каренина).

_also_card_surface_lemma(): on every card made from watch/read, if the tapped
word's lemma differs from the stored citation lemma, also record the surface
lemma as has_card so the view actually turns it green. Wired into _make_one_card
and text_card.

One-off cleanup: removed 7 never-reviewed duplicate cards, recorded сбираться.
